services.name: Centurion/ Supreme Wake Boat -14 People
services.desc: The Supreme S220 is a 22’ watersports boat with seating for 12 people. Powered by a GM Marine 6.0L 409hp engine, it features ZeroOff Pro GPS Cruise Control, 4,400 lbs. ballast, and a Wet Sounds Bluetooth sound system. Perfect for wakeboarding, wake surfing, tubing, and skiing. You can rent wakeboards, surfboards, tubes, and life jackets, or bring your own. Use is limited to deep water on Elk Lake only. Please call about boat deliveries to locations other than Elk
